breve: A StyleBox that displays a single line of a given color and thickness.
descricao: A StyleBox that displays a single line of a given color and thickness. The line can be either horizontal or vertical. Useful for separators.

propriedades.desc: The number of pixels the line will extend before the StyleBoxLine's bounds. If set to a negative value, the line will begin inside the StyleBoxLine's bounds.
The number of pixels the line will extend past the StyleBoxLine's bounds. If set to a negative value, the line will end inside the StyleBoxLine's bounds.
If true, the line will be vertical. If false, the line will be horizontal.
